rows.failed_witness: The first combined Git discovery wrapper returned no attributable output within its display window.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: The exact local, tracking, live, parent, history, and clean-state probes all passed.
rows.recovery: Use exact scalar ref, ancestry, worktree, and fresh-live probes with explicit JSON attribution.
rows.recurrence_guard: Prefer scalar Git probes over mixed worktree/ref discovery wrappers.

rows.failed_witness: The first full activation-packet render exceeded the result budget before EOF.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: All 464 committed lines were read through EOF and the Git-blob digest matched.
rows.recovery: Measure the committed packet and reread numbered line windows through the final line.
rows.recurrence_guard: Measure long packets before display and select bounded windows from the start.

rows.failed_witness: A combined multi-window activation reread again exceeded the display budget.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: The separate windows covered the packet without omission or mutation.
rows.recovery: Read one bounded window per command instead of aggregating several windows.
rows.recurrence_guard: Do not aggregate multiple near-budget text windows into one tool result.

rows.failed_witness: The combined authorization, roster, and portfolio-guidance display was truncated.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: Every named guidance file and both v669-v8 overlays were read completely.
rows.recovery: Read each skill, schema, mutable state, and live overlay separately.
rows.recurrence_guard: Separate large mutable-state files from surrounding skill guidance.

rows.failed_witness: A full pretty-printed authorization-state reread was truncated at 14,150 tokens.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: Four literal line windows covered the authorization state through EOF.
rows.recovery: Read the 1,557-line state in four bounded windows.
rows.recurrence_guard: Use line-window recovery immediately when a mutable state exceeds the result budget.

rows.failed_witness: A minified authorization-state projection still exceeded the result budget.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: The source-line recovery preserved ordering and all fields without relying on a truncated projection.
rows.recovery: Retain minification as a failed optimization and use bounded source-line windows.
rows.recurrence_guard: Do not assume JSON minification alone will fit a fixed output budget.

rows.failed_witness: The scoped lint preflight could not resolve a standalone ruff executable from PATH.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: The Python module entry point reported Ruff 0.16.4 without installing or changing the environment.
rows.recovery: Invoke the already-installed Ruff package through the active Python interpreter with python -m ruff.
rows.recurrence_guard: Prefer python -m ruff on this host unless an exact standalone executable path is verified first.

rows.failed_witness: The first module-based scoped Ruff check rejected two import blocks and three expression-style issues in the new x1 files.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: The unchanged two-file Ruff scope passed after the bounded mechanical correction.
rows.recovery: Apply Ruff's safe fixes to the two owner-local files, patch the two remaining simplifications, and rerun the identical scope.
rows.recurrence_guard: Run module-based Ruff immediately after authoring and before generating lifecycle artifacts.

rows.failed_witness: The first x1 build stopped before artifact writes because proposal IF6702-N002 crossed the declared semantic-neighbor collision threshold against Lyren's Git-blob manifest proposal.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: The unchanged x1 builder completed with zero semantic-neighbor collisions and wrote the planning-only packet.
rows.recovery: Inspect only the colliding pair, rewrite the Ilyra title around commit-object inventory semantics, and rerun the unchanged builder.
rows.recurrence_guard: Run the exact newest-owner neighbor audit before generating any lifecycle artifact.
